# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
|---------|--------------------|
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Steam Game Organizer, please report it to the repository owner directly.

**Do not** open a public issue for security concerns.

### What to include

- A description of the vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce (screenshots or logs if applicable)
- The affected version(s) of the app
- Your environment (Windows version, Python version if running from source)

### Response timeline

- **Acknowledgment:** Within 3 business days
- **Initial assessment:** Within 5 business days
- **Fix or workaround:** As soon as possible, depending on severity

### Disclosure

Vulnerabilities will be disclosed publicly only after a fix is available and users have had reasonable time to update. Credit will be given upon request.

### Scope

This policy covers the source code in this repository and the frozen exe distributed via GitHub Releases. Third-party dependencies (Python, Tcl/Tk, 7-Zip, Tesseract OCR) are out of scope — report those to their respective maintainers.
